subject: ddl: add lease for ingest distributed lock (#56184)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs its parent, focused on DDL ingest distributed-lock/lease behavior and call paths (disttask/local pipeline -> ingest backend). Change introduces `owner.AcquireDistributedLock` with TTL-backed etcd session and uses it during ingest import when an etcd client is provided; local ingest path now passes nil etcd client. No remaining Blocker/High issues found after checking upstream/master follow-up history for the touched lock code.
